usage: 獅子 (si1 zi2) is a noun that refers to the animal lion.
獅子 can be used to talk about the actual animal or to symbolize bravery in expressions.
You can use 獅子 to describe animals you see in zoos, books, or movies.
When talking about 獅子 in sentences, it can be the subject or object.
獅子 is often used in compound words or phrases related to animals or nature.
